cause: The physical iPhone would not accept attended page interaction while SafariDriver owned the Safari session. The operator disabled Remote Automation in order to type; disabling it invalidated the WebDriver session and Safari navigated away from the controlled page.
classification: carrier ownership conflict, not a product failure and not a claim result
impact: The first React keyboard cell reached the intended product field, proving that the corrected link-local CORS and insecure-context boot path worked. No attended text evidence was retained. The remaining cells failed after the device automation session was unavailable, so all four receipts and the aggregate are ineligible.
operatorReport: To type into the field i had to turn off automation and then it navigated awayfrom the page
nextAction: Do not rerun v2. Design and prospectively ratify a replacement carrier that does not require simultaneous SafariDriver ownership and human page interaction; preserve the unchanged fixture, claims, pass criteria, and physical soft-keyboard policy.
